title: Sheinbaum: Panistas Who Seek Support in Europe Repeat the Conduct of 19th-Century Conservatives
author: La Redacción
content:
_This article by La Redacción originally appeared in the[September 12, 2026
edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/12/politica/sheinbaum-
panistas-que-buscan-apoyo-en-europa-repiten-conducta-de-los-conservadores-del-
siglo-xix), Mexico's premier left-wing daily newspaper._

**Cancún, QR**. After noting that the caste society **" to this day is
reflected in some sectors of Mexican society as a reminiscence of the colonial
period,"** President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo compared the trip of a group of
Panistas to Europe with the conservatives who went to bring Maximilian of
Habsburg during the Second French Intervention in Mexico. She pointed out that
when Mexican liberalism triumphed, **" a little while later the conservatives,
like now, go off to Europe to seek support from abroad because they say there
is no Mexican who can govern Mexico, and they brought Maximilian, who stayed
five years as a colony, a French protectorate."**

Led by PAN leader Jorge Romero, five Panistas have for several days now been
touring Europe to seek alliances and to strengthen, as the man from the blue-
and-white party said, cooperation **" to build solutions for Mexican
families."**

![President Claudia Sheinbaum during her report
event](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/09/02-presidencia.jpg)Photo: Presidencia

This afternoon, while delivering her "Honesty and Results" report in Cancún,
President Sheinbaum Pardo stressed that sovereignty emanates from the people,
and that means:

> Its people define its destiny; no foreign power, no elite defines the
> destiny of the people of Mexico.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum

She mentioned that the discrimination of the caste society **" still persists
among some Mexicans; unfortunately it comes from there, from the colonial
era."**

Nevertheless, she emphasized that throughout history, the people of Mexico
have always fought for their independence, their sovereignty, and social
justice; **" they carry the word justice in their heart"** and are proud of
who we are.

She urged people to **" never forget that unity with the people is the most
important thing when it comes to transforming the homeland."** And **" no
difference is important when what is being defended is a better life for the
people… We must not forget that unity is with the people of Mexico and with
the defense of independence and sovereignty."**

![President Claudia Sheinbaum addresses the audience in
Cancún](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/09/03-presidencia.jpg)Photo: Presidencia

She also said that in 2018, with the arrival of Andrés Manuel López Obrador
and the Fourth Transformation, the country began to change **" and the essence
of our heroes of the Independence, the Reform, and the Revolution was
recovered, along with the yearnings of the people of Mexico for independence,
freedom, democracy, and well-being."**

She underscored that López Obrador left **" a beautiful legacy. So much so
that they criticize him every day, but we always say: they can criticize him,
but he stayed in the heart of the people and there he will remain."**

In her report, the president also mentioned that there is now a comprehensive
plan to clean up the sargassum, **" which this year was stronger than in
others,"** with an additional two billion pesos in investment for Quintana
Roo.

She indicated that more boats are being purchased and that there are **" other
ways of cleaning up the sargassum."**
